sources.purpose: Canceled game text supplies no modifiers or triggered actions; excluded characters are inactive; Besieged uses a separate selected character group and battles as if at a site. Open-vehicle occupants are present; enclosed occupants are not, although enclosed drivers retain battle-destiny ability.
Distinguishes opposing pilots present at sites for battle-destiny prevention from pilots at sites for mandatory cancellation; Vader exemption affects the former only.
Reduces opposing total ability where the bearer is present unless a Dark Jedi is present.

gempSourceReview.finding: Scramble uses presentAt(site) for prevention and at(site), including excluded cards, for cancellation. Affect Mind uses wherePresent(self) and a present Dark Jedi suppression condition.

verification.focusedResult: 19 passed; no failed, skipped, or canceled tests.
coverage: Selected attached pilots apply no battle-destiny ability under Scramble, retaining ordinary ability and presence.
Vader stays exempt but keeps Scramble active as a pilot.
Unselected system crew cannot keep Scramble active through virtual presence.
Departure and completion remove virtual presence and allow automatic cancellation.
Affect Mind reduces total ability in both system and docking-bay Besieged battles.
Unselected/outside and battle-prohibited Jedi or bearers cannot supply modifiers to the distinct trapped-crew battle.
Selected Dark Jedi suppress Affect Mind according to current individual ability.
Source loss, bearer deactivation, canceled text, and temporary source-duration suppression disable the correct continuous modifiers.
Suppressed or canceled Scramble does not trigger its own mandatory cancellation.
Serialized refresh preserves both-seat projections and validates saved state.
An opposing pilot riding an open vehicle is prevented by Scramble; an enclosed driver is not, although both still keep the Effect on table.
verification.regressionNote: Earlier consolidated ability, location-ability, and Besieged site-context regression run passed all 73 preexisting cases. Subsequent open-vehicle predicate change is covered by the final 19-case focused run; parent performs consolidated broad verification.

limitations: No executed GEMP Besieged oracle is claimed; pinned source review and official Besieged rules establish the integration interpretation.

Fixtures control initial placement, capture, source departures, game-text suppression/cancellation records, battle prohibitions, and stolen Landspeeder ownership. Besieged deployment, participant selection, initiation, optional passes, and normal completion use runtime commands.
Generic suppression tests validate trusted engine state/provider behavior; they do not claim a particular suppression card can naturally target either Effect.
This does not certify every named-location or remote continuous modifier during Besieged.
Full native deck admission remains closed.
